caseName: Southern Pacific Co. v. Eastern Glade
caseNameFull: Southern Pacific Co. v. The Eastern Glade and Same v. Postal Steamship Corporation
attorneys: Messrs. Chauncey I. Clark and Burton H. White for petitioner. Mr. John C. Crawley for respondents.

opinions.text:
The motion to use the certified record in Nos. 73 and 74, October Term, 1939, is granted. The petition for writs of certiorari to the. Circuit Court, of Appeals for the Second .Circuit is denied.

Reported below: 112 F. 2d 297.
